concepts.name: GPU Thermal Power Limit
concepts.definition: Maximum sustained power draw for inference GPUs, dynamically adjusted by thermal zone monitoring.

concepts.name: Agent Session State
concepts.definition: The lifecycle and context state of an active agent session, including PDD context inheritance.

concepts.name: PDD Intent Retrieval
concepts.definition: The process by which AI tools retrieve explicitly declared authoritative intent before generation.

concepts.name: GPU Model Routing
concepts.definition: The assignment of inference models to specific GPU hardware based on VRAM capacity and thermal constraints.

concepts.name: Agent Swarm Orchestration
concepts.definition: The decomposition of complex goals into atomic sub-tasks executed by bounded sub-agents inheriting root PDD context.

concepts.name: Knowledge Graph Maintenance
concepts.definition: The structural dependency map of the codebase, with node pruning and relationship tracking.

concepts.name: Reversa Behavioral Extraction
concepts.definition: The process of reverse-engineering behavioral specifications from existing code using the Reversa agent framework.

concepts.name: Workspace Security Scanning
concepts.definition: Mandatory security scan for every newly provisioned workspace, with failure blocking execution.

concepts.name: Context-as-Code Manifestation
concepts.definition: The practice of embedding governance rules as machine-readable, human-auditable context directly alongside code.

concepts.name: Computational Audit Trail
concepts.definition: The system log of prompt identity, governing intent references, model versions, context inputs, and review outcomes.
